items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: With the Golden Gate Quartet, and Jimmy Crawford -- Jimmy Crawford on drums. We made most of their dates.

ctx.x: How did you get into the theater?

Herman Chittison (phonetic) recommended me. "Venus on The Half Shell" I was working at the Diamond Horseshoe. Jackie Gleason was a stand up comedian then and Milton Berle, Toots Shore and Joe Dimaggio were his hecklers. And Milton Rosenstock was the conductor of the show. I can't think of the title right this minute. But he had been the conductor of "This Is The Army" with all the black performers and -- like Stump Cross, Honey Cole, those kind of people.
